## Current objective
Fix currency rounding in `ledgerly/money.py` so JPY has zero decimal places. PDF migration is paused/superseded; report optimization and CI workflow work are also paused.

## Key identifiers and corrections
Branch: `gha/test-workflow`; PDF renderer: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`; money helper: `ledgerly/billing/money.py`; tests: `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`; `format_money()`. `httpx==0.23` and Redis `cache-eu-1` are superseded; use `redis://cache-eu-3:6379` only.

## Ruled-out approaches
`httpx==0.23` broke the Stripe client. Filtering negative PDF line amounts with `amount <= 0` lost credit lines; current condition is `amount == 0`.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Preserve negative PDF lines after their invoice items.
- [done] Reuse `format_money()` in PDF rendering.
- [pending] Inspect JPY conversion/rounding and existing money tests.
- [pending] Add a JPY zero-decimal regression test and implement the fix.
- Exact next command: `rg 'JPY|round|quantize|format_money' ledgerly/money.py ledgerly/billing/money.py tests -n`

## Recent work
PDF focused tests pass, Ruff passes, and formatting comparison confirms shared helper output (`-12,345.60`). Page-break logic was noted as potentially using incorrect row-height units but is not yet changed.
